test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II (AAO) 2023 Official Paper-III (Held On: 27 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In relation to limitations of financial accounting, which of the following statements is INCORRECT ?

options.text: Financial accounting discloses the present value of the business.
Financial accounting is influenced by personal judgements.
Financial accounting ignores important non-monetary information.

solution:
The correct answer is** Financial accounting discloses the present value of the business.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• **Financial accounting discloses the present value of the business:**

 
 
• This statement is incorrect because financial accounting typically records assets and liabilities at their historical cost rather than their current or fair market value.
 
• Historical cost accounting does not reflect the present value of the business, which may be significantly different due to market fluctuations, inflation, or changes in the business environment.
 
• To ascertain the present value of the business, other valuation methods such as discounted cash flow analysis or market value assessments are required.
